summary_markdown:
Testing was conducted comparing two firmware versions (v52.1 and v53) with consumption optimization, using 2 sensors over a limited period.

Initial results showed differences in real and local measurements: +11% for new firmware (real diff) and -9.3% / +8% (local diff).

It was concluded that the observed differences were within the margin of error given the limited test scope (2 days, 2 sensors, non-crowded environment).

A subsequent discussion confirmed that the uploaded firmware version is intended for Germany only.
decisions: The comparison between v52.1 and v53 was deemed acceptable despite minor discrepancies.
